capabilities: Open notes with editor and preview side-by-side in an empty workspace
Split the current pane into two linked panes via a command
extras: Only works on desktop and tablet; Obsidian 1.0+ does not support split panes on phones.
intentEvidence: Opens notes with the editor & preview side-by-side
problem: Obsidian opens notes in a single pane, so viewing live preview and the editor together requires manually splitting panes each time.
summary: Splits the workspace so notes open with the editor and preview side-by-side, plus a command to split a pane into two linked panes.
